{"command": "python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
A=[int(x) for x in open('qr_code.txt')]
im=Image.new('L',(29,29),'white'); p=im.load()
for y,n in enumerate(A):
 for x in range(29): p[x,y]=0 if n>>(28-x)&1 else 255
im.resize((580,580)).save('/tmp/qr.png')
PY
python3 -m pip install --quiet opencv-python-headless", "timeout_seconds": 30}
